name: voltwise
description: > A smart power management and optimization platform designed to monitor, analyze, and reduce power consumption in real-time.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "ml,backend,app" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix app-voltwise -- -c"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "ml,backend,app" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix app-voltwise -- -c"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:app && npm run install:landing
scripts.add:env:all: npm run add:env:backend && npm run add:env:app
